/ About Me

A little about me

I am an analytics leader with 15+ years of experience helping organizations turn complex data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical business decisions. I hold a Master's degree in Business Analytics & Data Science from Bentley University in Waltham, Massachusetts, and have built much of my career working with organizations and cross-functional teams in the United States.

My work sits at the intersection of business strategy, data engineering, digital analytics, and business intelligence — allowing me to translate business questions into scalable analytics solutions. Over the years, I have led initiatives across web, marketing, content, audience, and business performance reporting, while improving how organizations collect, structure, and use data.

My strength lies in combining technical depth with business context. I bring strong technical proficiency across analytics, reporting, automation, data quality, and AI-assisted workflows, while shaping reporting strategy and helping teams move from scattered data and manual reporting to trusted insights and confident decisions.

/ Services

How I can help

Here are the key areas where I help teams strengthen reporting, analytics, and decision-making.

01

Analytics Strategy & KPI Frameworks

Create clarity around what matters most by defining meaningful KPIs, setting reporting priorities, and building analytics roadmaps aligned with business goals.

02

Data Integration & Reporting Automation

Replace fragmented data and manual reporting with connected, automated workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and confidence in reporting.

03

Dashboards & Business Reporting

Turn complex data into intuitive, decision-ready dashboards that make performance easier to understand, highlight meaningful trends, and surface opportunities quickly.

04

Performance & Business Insights

Move beyond surface-level metrics to uncover the drivers behind performance, identify gaps and opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

05

Data Quality, Governance & Team Enablement

06

Fractional Analytics Lead

Bring senior-level analytics leadership to teams that need strategic direction, stakeholder alignment, reporting oversight, and stronger analytics processes — without the need for a full-time hire.
